label: Acidic stomach
note: Acidic reading with no respiratory waveform.

label: Neutral oesophagus
note: High pH and no waveform remain inconclusive.

label: Raised gastric pH
note: Simulated acid suppression or recent feed; pH about 6.2.

label: Acid reflux confounder
note: Same sensor values as P01 despite different location; exposes non-identifiability.

label: Connection dropout
note: Missing packets from 15 to 25 s; reacquire a full window.

label: Isolated CO2 spike
note: One 0.6 s spike at 20 s; no repeating respiratory pattern.

label: Weak airway waveform
note: Diluted waveform around 8 mmHg; do not require a normal end-tidal peak.

label: Complete normal feed
note: 30 mL delivered over 30 min at 60 mL/hr.

label: Pump raised
note: Height rises from +0.3 to +0.8 m; raw pressure falls without added resistance.

label: Pump lowered
note: Height drops from +0.3 to -0.3 m; raw pressure rises without added resistance.

label: Partial obstruction
note: Both flows decline together while corrected pressure loss increases.

label: Complete obstruction
note: Both flows approach zero; pressure builds and alert latches; pump stops at 120 s.

label: Leak or flow disagreement
note: Proximal 60 vs distal 30 mL/hr; elevated resistance is absent.

label: Connection dropout
note: No measured data from 80 to 100 s; known volume excludes missing intervals.

label: Resistance, flow maintained
note: Pump maintains flow while pressure rises; catches obstruction without mismatch.

label: Intentional pause
note: Command and both flows are zero from 60 to 100 s; avoid divide-by-zero and false obstruction.
